item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00194","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C18","C11","C12"],"selected_candidate_label":"C18","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C18 is expressly one of the two orders whose railroad control the child directs the Secretary of the Army to terminate. It supplies the exact administrative machinery and core terminology reused by the child: federal “possession, control, and operation” of railroad transportation systems through the Secretary, followed by termination when that control is no longer necessary. C11 is an equally direct antecedent for the other affected system, while C12 is a strong earlier model for the same machinery but is not itself identified as the control being terminated.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The labor disputes underlying the issuance of [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE], dated ... August 25, 1950, have now been settled","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS I find that as a result of labor disturbances there are interruptions, and threatened interruptions, of the operations of the transportation systems","explanation":"The child expressly identifies C18 by date and states that its labor-dispute predicate has ended."},{"child_excerpt":"termination of possession, control and operation of the transportation systems affected by the above mentioned Executive Orders","parent_excerpt":"Possession, control, and operation of the transportation systems ... are hereby taken and assumed, through the Secretary of the Army","explanation":"The child reverses the precise control regime established by C18, reusing its distinctive tripartite terminology and agency assignment."},{"child_excerpt":"initiate immediate steps for the termination ... to become effective at the earliest feasible moment","parent_excerpt":"Possession, control, and operation of any transportation system ... shall be terminated by the Secretary when he determines that such possession, control, and operation are no longer necessary","explanation":"C18 expressly delegates termination of the railroad control to the Secretary; the child activates that same termination machinery after settlement of the disputes."}]}
